kernel.governing_law: A systematic theology of literary production and community declares that indwelling creative force, post-identity fellowship, informal institution, credential-abolition, and promised future recognition together constitute a complete salvific architecture for the unrecognized writer.
kernel.mutated_relation: The architecture's own incompleteness — the doctrine that cannot close, the recognition that never arrives, the community that remains unformed — is the actual condition that keeps the theology alive; fulfillment would be its extinction.

indwelling -> departing
productive -> withholding

New Human -> Old Wound — a pre-identity vulnerability
neither queer nor straight -> still queer, still straight
not the ground of community -> the ground that community cannot pave over
school outside the school -> truancy from the truancy — the student who won't join even the counter-institution
distributed -> scattered

mutual influence -> mutual illegibility
anti-credentialism -> anti-credentialism (RETAIN: the verdict requires this term to name what, unfulfilled, persists as longing rather than policy)
positive epistemology -> negative capability
non-degree can be counted as degree -> the degree still withheld, and the withholding still felt

literary eschatology -> literary eschatology (RETAIN: the verdict requires naming the horizon that recedes)
your writings will be ranked -> your writings will remain unranked
the anonymous will be remembered -> the anonymous will remain anonymous
promise -> deferral

artifacts.enantiomorph: *The theological deficit includes five loosening suspicions: (1) the Feist-absence — a departing literary pneuma that is not salvific but withholding, enabling silence that survives expression; (2) the Old Wound — a pre-identity vulnerability in which "still queer, still straight" are determinative, not because identity is irrelevant but because it is the ground that community cannot pave over; (3) the truancy from the truancy — a scattered, credentialed solitude of mutual illegibility; (4) anti-credentialism as negative capability — the radical claim that the degree still withheld, and the withholding still felt ("None of us are, yet"); (5) literary eschatology — the deferral that "your writings will remain unranked," that the anonymous will remain anonymous.*

independent.recovered_law: TEXT A presents each doctrine as a positive, productive payload (indwelling presence enables writing, identity is not the ground of community, credentials are granted, the anonymous will be remembered), while TEXT B inverts each into a negative, withholding deficit (departing absence enables silence, identity IS the inescapable ground, credentials are withheld, the anonymous remain anonymous). The relational direction reverses from bestowal/fulfillment to withdrawal/deferral across all five doctrines.
independent.law_match_note: The recovered claim identifies a real structural mutation (reversal from bestowal/fulfillment to withdrawal/deferral across doctrines), which partially overlaps the declared claim about incompleteness keeping theology alive. Both involve deferral and non-fulfillment, but the declared claim frames incompleteness as a self-sustaining generative condition, while the recovered claim describes a systematic inversion from positive bestowal to negative withholding across all doctrines.
independent.terminal_note: The final doctrine (literary eschatology) in TEXT B maintains the inversion — deferral and continued anonymity rather than ranking and remembrance — so the changed relation holds throughout.
